blocks.text: For a company whose work is closely tied to the movement of people across the world’s oceans, growth is measured not only in ships and destinations, but also in the opportunities created for the people who keep the maritime industry moving. For CF Sharp Crew Management Inc., that growth takes a new, tangible form with the opening of its new office at Harton Corporate Center in Aseana City. The facility marks an important step in the company’s continuing development, while reinforcing its commitment to Filipino seafarers and the families who support them.
